scope: Callback-relative proof for organic fourth-slot Select Opponent selection from power-on.

claim_audit.claim: Callback-relative input windows keyed to the first live 01:C1D2 hit now drive the fourth Select Opponent slot organically ($1C70 = 3), after which the run reaches L00BE76 and the later 01:BE43 corridor with $1C76 = 0.
evidence: validation/mesen_probe_boot.lua now accepts TD2_BOOT_PROBE_TRIGGER_INPUT_WINDOWS and records both trigger_input_windows and exec_point_trace.first_frames in the probe JSON.

tools/out/select_opponent_clock_path_v5_trigger/td2_boot_probe.json records trigger_input_windows c1d2+1-6:right,down and c1d2+8-13:start, first c1d2 at frame 1628, state_1c70 = 3 / state_1c76 = 0 by frame 1642, and l00be76 at frame 1642.
The same v5 run then samples active_main = 01:BE43 at frames 1713, 1736, 1857, 1887, 2014, and 2044 with no traced b87, 902d, or 9111 hit.

tools/out/select_opponent_clock_path_v6_trigger_long/td2_boot_probe.json reproduces first c1d2 at 1628, l00be76 at 1642, first be43 at 1713, and keeps state_1c70 = 3 / state_1c76 = 0 with active_main = 01:BE43 through sampled frames 2200, 2400, and 2600, still with no traced b87, 902d, or 9111 hit.
tools/out/snes_select_opponent_callback_relative_selection.md consolidates the two callback-relative runs and scopes the remaining open edge.
claim_audit.notes: This closes organic fourth-slot selection itself. It does not yet prove the later no-opponent phase-confirm behavior because the v5/v6 input program omits the later confirm start window that previously advanced the default-rival lane into L008B87 -> 01:902D -> active_main = 02:9016.

scenarios.notes: Short callback-relative proof run. It closes the fourth-slot move but does not include a later phase-confirm input.
Long follow-up run. It shows the fourth-slot state persisting into the later 01:BE43 corridor, but still without a later phase-confirm input.

next_gate: Pair the callback-relative fourth-slot move with a later start confirm after the 01:BE43 corridor is live so the no-opponent lane can be compared against the default-rival baseline.
